concepts.title: Conduction of Heat
concepts.definition: Hold one end of a metal spoon in hot tea and the other end warms up: heat travels through solids from particle to particle without the substance moving, called conduction, fast in metals and slow in wood or plastic.
concepts.key_idea: Conduction is heat passing hand to hand through matter: conductors pass it on, insulators hold it back.
question_patterns: what is conduction of heat
why do metal spoons get hot in tea
which materials are good conductors of heat
why are pan handles made of wood or plastic
compare conduction in metal and wood
design an activity to compare conductors and insulators

solution_steps.explain: Note exactly what happens in the activity.
Write down which cases show it and which do not.
State the rule your observations reveal.

concepts.title: Convection in Liquids and Gases
concepts.definition: In water and air, heated fluid itself rises and cooler fluid sinks to take its place, setting up circulating currents called convection, the currents that boil water from below and blow the sea breeze.
concepts.key_idea: Convection moves heat by moving matter: hot fluid up, cool fluid down, round and round.
question_patterns: how does heat travel through liquids and gases
explain convection currents in boiling water
why does warm air rise
how does convection explain sea breeze
why are room heaters placed near the floor
demonstrate convection with coloured warm water

solution_steps.explain: Note exactly what happens in the activity.
Write down which cases show it and which do not.
State the rule your observations reveal.

concepts.title: Radiation: Heat without a Medium
concepts.definition: The sun's heat crosses empty space to reach us without any medium: this transfer by invisible waves is radiation, felt from a fire across the room or from any hot object nearby.
concepts.key_idea: Radiation needs no material bridge: heat can fly through vacuum itself.
question_patterns: how does heat reach us from the sun
what is radiation of heat
why do we feel warm near a fire without touching it
does radiation need a medium
why do we wear white clothes in summer
compare the three modes of heat transfer

solution_steps.explain: Write the two ideas or groups side by side.
Note the points on which they differ and one point they share.
State in one line what the comparison teaches.

concepts.title: Heat, Land, Water and the Cycle of Weather
concepts.definition: Land heats fast and cools fast, water heats slowly and cools slowly; this unequal partnership drives breezes and monsoons, and with evaporation and condensation it keeps the water cycle turning through nature.
concepts.key_idea: Weather is heat transfer written large: land, water and sun run the cycle of breeze, cloud and rain.
question_patterns: why does land heat faster than water
how do land and sea breezes form
what role does heat transfer play in the water cycle
why is kerala warmer than sikkim
explain evaporation and condensation in nature
connect conduction convection and radiation in daily weather
